prompt: ok i'm writing up an arch review for our team — we're moving the contoso payment service to azure. it'll be an app service (P2v3, just westus2 for now, multi-region later), backing onto an azure sql db (general purpose), with private endpoints between them. key vault holds the connection strings, app insights for telemetry. one resource group (rg-payment-prod), one vnet (10.20.0.0/16) with two subnets — snet-app and snet-data. can you draw me an svg architecture diagram I can paste into the doc?

assertions.text: Output file diagram.svg exists and parses as valid XML
SVG uses official Microsoft App Service icon (contains <symbol id="icon-app-services"> or <use href="#icon-app-services">)
SVG uses official Microsoft SQL Database icon
SVG uses official Microsoft Key Vault and Application Insights icons
SVG renders distinct nested container boundaries for the resource group, vnet, and at least one subnet (visible as nested <rect> elements with stroke)
SVG includes labeled edges between App Service and SQL (text mentions 'private endpoint' or similar)
SVG is more than 6 KB (indicating non-trivial inlined icon content, not just labeled rectangles)
